name: excalidraw
description: Manage Excalidraw through authenticated CLI tools with built-in Codex browser login/key acquisition and browser fallback for unsupported client actions.

interface.longDescription: Default to authenticated CLI/client operations for workspaces, collections, scenes, users/invites, backups, rendering, and recovery. Use the built-in browser to select the project account and obtain missing login/keys securely, verify CLI identity and target, and fall back to browser operations only when the authenticated client lacks the requested capability.
defaultPrompt: Verify my Excalidraw CLI authentication for this project and use browser-assisted setup if missing.
Inspect my Excalidraw resources with the authenticated client.
Perform this Excalidraw operation through CLI, using browser only if unsupported.
